name: Before any deal the deck holds all 16 cards
rule_text: The deck has 16 cards: Ace, Ten, Ober and Unter of Acorns, Leaves, Hearts and Bells. Card points are Ace 11, Ten 10, Ober 3, Unter 2, totalling 104.

name: After 18 rounds (two hands of 9 rounds) the match is in hand 3
rule_text: The match is 4 hands of 9 rounds each (1 bidding round, then 8 trick rounds), 36 rounds in all.

name: Seat 1 is forehand in hand 2, so it declares when both pass
rule_text: Seat 1 deals hands 1 and 3 and seat 2 deals hands 2 and 4. The non-dealer is forehand.

name: After the deal each seat holds 4 hand cards and the deck is empty
rule_text: At the start of each hand all 16 cards are shuffled. Each player gets 4 private hand cards plus 2 stacks of one face-down card under one face-up card.

name: Each seat's private hand holds exactly 4 cards after the deal
rule_text: Hand cards are visible only to their owner, face-up stack cards to both players, and face-down cards to neither player.

name: Both seats are offered every bid and the bids are recorded
rule_text: Both players bid secretly and simultaneously: Pass, 53, 66 or 79.

name: Higher bidder (seat 1, 79 over 53) is declarer at 79
rule_text: When the bids differ, the higher bidder is declarer at their bid.

name: Equal bids of 66: forehand seat 2 declares at 66
rule_text: When both bid the same number (not Pass), forehand is declarer at that bid.

name: Both pass: forehand seat 2 declares at 53
rule_text: When both pass, forehand is declarer at 53.

name: Both bids are announced along with the declarer
rule_text: Both bids are announced after the declarer is determined.

name: Declarer seat 2 picks Wenz; the defender is not asked for a contract
rule_text: The declarer chooses Acorns Solo, Leaves Solo, Hearts Solo, Bells Solo or Wenz, and the choice is announced.

name: A Hearts Solo hand plays all 8 tricks for any deal: every hand card is used and hand 2 begins
rule_text: In a Solo the trumps, from highest to lowest, are: Ober of Acorns, Leaves, Hearts, Bells; then Unter of Acorns, Leaves, Hearts, Bells; then the Ace and Ten of the chosen suit. Each other suit holds only Ace above Ten.

name: A Wenz hand plays all 8 tricks for any deal
rule_text: In Wenz the trumps, from highest to lowest, are Unter of Acorns, Leaves, Hearts, Bells. Each suit holds Ace above Ten above Ober.

name: Defender seat 1 gives Stoss: multiplier 2; the declarer is not asked
rule_text: The defender chooses Stoß (multiplier 2) or No Stoß (multiplier 1), and the choice is announced.

name: Defender seat 1 gives No Stoss: multiplier 1
rule_text: The defender chooses Stoß (multiplier 2) or No Stoß (multiplier 1), and the choice is announced.

name: Hand cards and stack cards together supply all 8 tricks: no hand card is left after the hand
rule_text: A player's available cards are their private hand cards plus the face-up card on top of each of their stacks.

name: Lead passes correctly through the 8 tricks for any deal, and the hand completes
rule_text: In trick 1 forehand leads. In each later trick the previous trick's winner leads.

name: A Bells Solo hand with trumps as one suit completes all tricks for any deal
rule_text: All trumps form one suit, so in a Solo an Ober or Unter never counts as its printed suit, and in Wenz an Unter never counts as its printed suit.

name: Following under the follow-suit rule always leaves a legal card: the hand completes
rule_text: When the follower has an available card of the led suit, they must play one. Otherwise they may play any available card.

name: Trick winners are decided in a Leaves Solo for any deal and the hand completes
rule_text: When any trump is played, the higher trump wins the trick. Otherwise the higher card of the led suit wins.

name: Trick points accrue over a full hand for any deal (hand completes)
rule_text: The trick winner adds the card points of both cards to their hand_points and 1 to tricks_won.

name: Face-down cards turn up so all 8 tricks can be played
rule_text: After a trick, the face-down card under any face-up card played in that trick turns face up and is available from the next trick on.

name: Without Stoss at bid 53 a seat gains at most 3 per hand, so a 13-point lead holds for any deal
rule_text: After trick 8, if the declarer's hand_points are at least contract_bid, the declarer scores the contract value in match points. Otherwise the defender scores it.

name: With Stoss at bid 53 a seat gains at most 6 per hand, so a 25-point lead holds for any deal
rule_text: The contract value is (base + 1 if the scorer took all 8 tricks) times the multiplier, where the base is 2 for 53, 3 for 66 and 4 for 79. For example, a 66 bid made with Stoß and not every trick scores 6.

name: Hand scoring runs after trick 8 and the next hand begins
rule_text: After each hand, each player's hand_points are added to their card_total.

name: After 36 rounds more match points wins: a 100-point head start cannot be caught
rule_text: After 36 rounds the game ends. More match points wins, card_total breaks ties, and if both are equal the match is a draw.
